statements.status_notes: Redis RESP CRLF injection in RedisEncoder. The netty-codec-redis jar is embedded inside the Cassandra Java driver shaded uber-jars (cql-*.jar, persistence-cassandra-4.0-*.jar). Stargate has no Redis backend or RESP listener; the only configured persistence backend is Apache Cassandra. The Redis codec classes are never loaded or instantiated. Upstream fix in 4.1.133.Final is pinned via mvn-properties netty.version, but the cassandra-driver shaded jars carry their own pre-shaded 4.1.132.Final copies that the property override cannot rewrite.
